turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Hi, this is Elena! Thanks for calling back so fast.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Hi Elena, thanks for requesting a demo. HyperSale helps SDRs ramp faster through realistic AI buyer practice and quote-backed scoring—are you onboarding now?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Yes, we onboard four to six new SDRs every quarter, and I run all of the training myself. I can’t listen to every practice call, so I’m looking for a way to help them feel less nervous before they start cold calling.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: HyperSale gives each rep realistic AI roleplays, and every score cites the exact quote, so managers track improvement weekly. Could we demo Thursday?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: That makes sense, especially being able to track improvement weekly. Thursday could work—what time were you thinking, and how long does setup usually take?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Would Thursday at 2 work? The demo takes 30 minutes, and setup is usually quick; I’ll also show roleplays, scoring, and manager dashboards.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Thursday at 2 works for me. I’d especially like to see how each rep’s improvement shows over time and what “quick” typically means for setup. Great, talk soon!
